findings: REPAIR-001 missing entirely — The HIGH priority integration test for full V0-V10 verification with disposable PostgreSQL was not created. Create test_full_verification_pipeline_with_real_database that spins up a disposable database, runs all verification stages, and validates cleanup.

Commands.jsonl test doesn't verify file content — test_commands_logged_to_jsonl exits early with assert True instead of reading commands.jsonl and validating entries. Implement actual file read and JSON parsing verification.

SQL parsing tests use local stub — test_migration_audit_parses_real_sql defines its own parse_sql_statements function instead of importing from the actual migration audit agent. Import the production parser or remove the test.

Concurrency tests don't verify race conditions — test_evidence_ledger_race_condition_detection only counts valid records, doesn't check for partial writes, interleaved lines, or corrupted JSON that would indicate an actual race condition. Add assertions for corruption patterns.

Empty input edge case missing — No test verifies behavior when _get_git_sha() or verify_commit_identity() receive empty strings, None, or whitespace-only output from git commands. Add edge case tests.
Malformed data edge case missing — No test verifies SQL parsing handles malformed SQL syntax (unmatched parentheses, unterminated strings, invalid keywords). Add malformed SQL test cases.

Port allocation not dynamic — test_verification_runner_disposable_db_cleanup hardcodes port 55432 in the database URL instead of using dynamic port allocation from a fixture. Update to use pytest fixture with dynamic port.
